topics.caution: The explanation could soften or drop why Ida's lighthouse appointment was only 'હંગામી' — the chapter states the reason plainly: 'આવા જોખમી કાર્ય માટે મહિલાની પસંદગી થતી ન હતી' (women were not chosen for such risky work), a real gender bar of the period.
topics.guidance: In the explanation or real_life_example, give the reason exactly as the chapter states it — a temporary appointment because women were not selected for such work — without adding an extra stereotype or an invented present-day fix the text does not offer.

topics.caution: The explanation could erase the chapter's own closing point that 'મહિલાને અધિકાર ન જ મળ્યો' and that Ida stayed 'હંગામી' her whole working life despite her record, or could turn it into a grievance the chapter's own line does not carry.
topics.guidance: Keep the chapter's own two-part framing in the explanation — her competence was recognised, formal authority was still withheld — and let the line 'સમગ્ર પુરુષજાત તેને સલામ કરી રહી' stand as the text's own way of naming that gap, without adding commentary beyond it.

chapter_level.guidance: All three rescues (M1.S1.T1, M2.S2.T2, M3.S3.T3) show Ida going out alone onto open water in a storm, at times at night, to pull people from the sea. Inside the explanation or real_life_example, frame this as Ida's trained, lifelong lighthouse duty — never as something for a child to attempt; a child who sees someone struggling in rough water should call an adult or emergency help, never go into the water alone.
